terra.problem: “A city for the priests” describes Anathoth’s allotment, but Joshua 21:17–19 does not say where the allotment took place.
“Abiathar sent home” concerns fields in Anathoth, but 1 Kings 2:25–27 does not say Solomon spoke to Abiathar there.
“Jeremiah’s hometown” says the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah in Anathoth. Jeremiah 1:1–10 identifies him with Anathoth but does not say where he received this word.
“Danger from his own people” identifies the people as being from Anathoth, but Jeremiah 11:21–23 does not say where they threatened Jeremiah.
“Jeremiah buys a field” concerns land in Anathoth, but the purchase took place while Jeremiah was in the courtyard of the guard, not at the field (Jeremiah 32:8–12).
Words such as “descendants,” “pasturelands,” and “prophesy” may be difficult at a fifth-grade reading level. Consider simpler wording or brief explanations.
